title: F5: Downgrade Wild::Skillops claims to match what the code can actually back up
description: Council rev2 §F5. Lamport caught the 'atomic' lie; Cunningham, Armstrong, DHH, Hickey, Beck, Fowler concur. Old wild-skillops-registry shipped v0.1.0 with no consumers AND claimed properties the code cannot back up. Resolution inside the consolidation: inline as Wild::Skillops internal namespace; remove all atomicity/durability claims; default config.skillops.enabled = false. Earn separate gem (ADR-0002) when a real consumer appears with proven need. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F4: Land shared schemas-as-data under lib/wild/schemas/ to prevent cross-namespace contract drift
description: Council rev2 §F4. Hickey's schemas-as-data answer; Fowler's shared corpus answer; Kleppmann's schema-version contract answer all agree. Specifically: lib/wild/schemas/wildcard_corpus.yml must be shared between Wild::Analyzers::Permission and Wild::CapabilityGate so the two cannot drift on what counts as a wildcard. Telemetry pipeline normalization schema, audit-event schema, MCP response schemas — all in lib/wild/schemas/ as YAML, loaded once. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F3: Replace vanity test counts with judgment tests across all namespaces
description: Council rev2 §F3. Beck explicit; Karpathy implicit (transport tests, no agent evals); Armstrong implicit (no audit-liveness probe); Lamport, Huyen concur. Today the old gems brag about test counts; many tests assert code runs without asserting judgment is correct. Resolution: characterization tests against captured behavior; golden corpora for classifiers; audit-liveness probes; agent-eval seams in bin/eval. NOT a count metric. Test count is forbidden as a quality claim. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F2: Make every CapabilityGate rescue emit a structured audit event; :evaluation_error is hard-fail
description: Council rev2 §F2. Armstrong's most-leveraged finding; Beck, Fowler, Kleppmann concur. Today the gate has rescue paths that silently swallow exceptions, leaving no audit trace. Fix: every rescue inside lib/wild/capability_gate/ emits a structured Wild::CapabilityGate audit event with outcome: :evaluation_error AND denies the request. Evidence required: audit-liveness spec deliberately corrupts policy fixture and asserts both event emission and outcome=:deny. See schemas/capability_gate/audit_event.yml for shape. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F1: Collapse nine broken Configuration singletons into one Wild::Configuration block
description: Council rev2 §F1. Every old wild-* gem ships a Configuration singleton with freeze!/reset! that fails in subtle ways (Hickey: gap-miner, Fowler: permission-analyzer, Armstrong: capability-gate duplicate Registry, Karpathy: introspection server_context[:api_key] undocumented). All seats hit it independently. Resolution: one Wild::Configuration with nested accessors (lib/wild/configuration.rb skeleton already present). Per-namespace settings collapse into config.<namespace>.<setting>. Evidence required at close: passing spec/engine/configuration_spec.rb + zero per-namespace Configuration classes remaining. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: Consolidate the wild ecosystem into one Rails engine gem (4-week build)
description: Master epic for the 4-week build of jeremylongshore/wild per the locked plan. Five phases (P0-P4), eleven roles, four critical handoff gates. Source of truth: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/build-orchestration/README.md and /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md.

title: Set up CodeQL with security-extended on ruby + actions matrix
description: Adds .github/workflows/codeql.yml + .github/codeql/codeql-config.yml + 000-docs/007-AT-STND-codeql-strategy.md per the 5-phase strategy (audit → plan → implement → validate → handoff). security-extended on, security-and-quality off until end of P1. Scoped to lib/wild/**, lib/generators/**, bin/wild-mcp-*, .github/workflows/**. Future custom query pack candidates documented (rb/wild/audit-emission-required at top of leverage). v0.1.0 cycle blocks on critical+high severity; medium becomes blocking post-v0.1.0. Strategy doc is the canonical reference.

title: MIN-Armstrong: Ship Wild::Error base hierarchy (~30 LOC) for consumer-distinguishable errors
description: Council rev2 preserved minority dissent (Armstrong explicit). Skeleton landed in lib/wild/error.rb on this commit. To close: per-namespace error subclasses defined (Wild::CapabilityGate::DeniedError, Wild::CapabilityGate::EvaluationError, Wild::Introspection::ForbiddenError, etc per 000-docs/003-AT-ARCH-architecture.md § Error hierarchy); rescue patterns at every namespace boundary use specific classes; spec asserts consumer can rescue at any tree level. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: MIN-Karpathy: Ship prompts/ directory + versioned MCP tool descriptions + bin/eval stub as v1, non-negotiable
description: Council rev2 preserved minority dissent (Karpathy explicit, non-negotiable). For each MCP server: prompts/<namespace>/<tool>.md is a versioned tool description; schemas/<namespace>/<tool>.yml is the response shape; bin/eval is a stub script that loads the prompts and runs a smoke eval. Cheap to ship in v1; v2 grows the 30-prompt agent-eval CI gate from these seams. Evidence at close: each MCP tool has a prompts/ file referenced by its tool registration; bin/eval prints scaffolding without crashing. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: MIN-Kleppmann: Decide fsync per append OR drop append-only audit log framing from telemetry collector
description: Council rev2 preserved minority dissent (Kleppmann + Hickey). DHH defers; the other two hold the line. Compromise: either fdatasync per append OR drop 'append-only audit log' framing from every README. v0.1.0 picks the latter for Wild::Telemetry::Collector — it's a process-local buffer, not a durable log. ADR amendment if a real durable-log consumer appears. Evidence at close: README + CHANGELOG no longer claim 'append-only audit log' for collector OR fsync ships and benchmarks live in spec/wild/telemetry/collector/. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F10: Cut back BDUF docs that predate any consumer (Wild::Skillops, flake-forensics surface)
description: Council rev2 §F10 (DHH, Cunningham). Old wild-* gems shipped 20 docs each before any of them had a user. Resolution under consolidation: the unified 000-docs/ set (6 docs + ADRs) is the canonical scope. Per-namespace internal notes live in lib/wild/<namespace>/NOTES.md when needed, not as a 20-document set per namespace. Anything that predates real usage gets a 'pending consumer feedback' note or is deleted. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F9: Build rails g wild:install generator to make the adoption story work
description: Council rev2 §F9 (DHH, Karpathy, Cunningham implicitly). Today there is no rails g anywhere; consumers must hand-author every YAML and wire every initializer. Resolution: lib/generators/wild/install/install_generator.rb (skeleton present) writes config/initializers/wild.rb, config/wild/access_policy.yml, config/wild/capabilities.yml, and mounts Wild::Engine at /wild in routes.rb. Generator spec asserts each file's contents. Stopwatch test exercises this generator end-to-end. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F8: Decomplect identity, value, and time in telemetry/analysis data shapes
description: Council rev2 §F8 (Hickey, Lamport, Pike). Old gap-miner Gap class complects identity (gap-id), value (gap-content), and time (created-at). Resolution: separate the three; identity is a UUID; value is an immutable record; time is a sequence-numbered event. DHH-Hickey tension on ActiveModel vs Data.define remains preserved per rev2 — Wild::Telemetry::Analysis::Gap uses ActiveModel for Rails ergonomics while underlying value is Data.define-compatible. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F7: Add boundary normalization wherever data crosses namespaces
description: Council rev2 §F7 (Hickey, Kleppmann, Karpathy). Hickey: missing ingest normalizer in gap-miner. Kleppmann: missing sequence number in telemetry. Karpathy: missing list_allowed_models discovery in introspection. Same shape, different symptom: no Wild::Telemetry::Normalize step that gives every downstream consumer one canonical shape. Resolution: lib/wild/telemetry/pipeline/normalize.rb takes the union of collector shapes and emits canonical events with sequence numbers. Downstream (Analysis) consumes only normalized events. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md

title: F6: Audit and either wire or delete every half-published API surface across the namespaces
description: Council rev2 §F6 (Armstrong, Kleppmann, Beck, Pike). Capability-gate's Session/Store (unwired). Telemetry's five exception classes never raised. Test-flake-forensics' three exporters where one is markdown-minus-headers. Pattern is the same: code written, tested, shipped, never connected. Per Conceptual Compression: if it has no consumer, it has no contract. Resolution: delete the dead ones; wire the live ones; document in CHANGELOG under each affected namespace. Source: /home/jeremy/000-projects/wild/wild-rails-ai-ops/000-docs/013-AT-AUDT-thinker-council-verdict-rev2-2026-05-29.md
